description: This file contains SQL scripts to create and manage the 'work_item' table in a PostgreSQL database, specifically for use with Supabase. It includes table creation, index setup, security policies, and functions/triggers for automatically assigning incremental IDs per project. The script facilitates managing tasks and bugs within projects using a unified table structure.

methods.name: public.fn_work_item_assign_incremental_id
methods.description: Function that assigns the next incremental ID to a new work item within the same project, ensuring unique sequential IDs per project.

calls: select coalesce(max(w.id), 0) + 1 from public.work_item w where w.project_id = NEW.project_id
